title: Salvianolic Acid B Protects Against Contrast-Induced Acute Kidney Injury by Attenuating Ferroptosis via the SIRT1/Nrf2 Pathway.
authors: Yuan, Hongtao; Shi, Xiang; Qin, Jiaming; Wang, Yue; Yuan, Yinuo; Zhang, Yutong; Wang, Yiran; Zhang, Chen; Zhu, Jinxia; Chen, Lihua; Xie, Shuangshuang; Shen, Wen
journal: FASEB journal : official publication of the Federation of American Societies for Experimental Biology
one_liner_zh: 该研究探讨丹酚酸B通过SIRT1/Nrf2通路抑制铁死亡保护造影剂肾损伤，仅涉及小分子-蛋白对接，无蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: Contrast-induced acute kidney injury (CI-AKI) poses a significant clinical challenge and contributes to a considerable healthcare burden. Ferroptosis has been increasingly recognized as an important mechanism of renal tubular epithelial cell injury in CI-AKI. Salvianolic acid B (SalB), a natural compound with anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, has shown protective effects in various kidney diseases. However, its role in CI-AKI-associated ferroptosis has not been fully clarified. In this study, we established a rat model of CI-AKI by subcutaneous injection of carbon tetrachloride for 6 weeks followed by iopamidol administration, and an in vitro model using iopamidol-treated HK-2 cells. Effects of tubular injury and ferroptosis were examined both in vivo and in vitro. Cycloheximide chase assay, cellular thermal shift assay, and molecular docking were used to assess the binding capacity of SalB to SIRT1. Our results showed that SalB significantly alleviated renal injury, reduced iron accumulation, oxidative stress levels, and lipid peroxidation, upregulated the expression of SLC7A11 and GPX4, and downregulated ACSL4 expression in both iopamidol-treated rat kidneys and HK-2 cells. Mechanistically, SalB targeted and bound to SIRT1, enhancing its stability, thereby promoting Nrf2 upregulation and nuclear translocation, which in turn enhanced the expression of SLC7A11 and GPX4 and attenuated ferroptosis. Silencing either SIRT1 or Nrf2 in HK-2 cells partially abrogated the protective effect of SalB. Collectively, our results support SalB as a viable treatment strategy for CI-AKI.
abstract_zh: 对比剂诱导的急性肾损伤（CI-AKI）构成重大临床挑战，并带来显著医疗负担。铁死亡（ferroptosis）日益被认为是CI-AKI中肾小管上皮细胞损伤的重要机制。丹酚酸B（SalB）是一种具有抗炎和抗氧化特性的天然化合物，已在多种肾脏疾病中显示出保护作用。然而，其在CI-AKI相关铁死亡中的作用尚未完全阐明。在本研究中，我们通过皮下注射四氯化碳6周后给予碘帕醇建立CI-AKI大鼠模型，并使用碘帕醇处理的HK-2细胞建立体外模型。在体内和体外均检测了肾小管损伤和铁死亡的影响。采用环己酰亚胺追踪实验、细胞热位移实验和分子对接评估SalB与SIRT1的结合能力。结果表明，SalB显著减轻肾损伤，减少铁积累、氧化应激水平和脂质过氧化，上调SLC7A11和GPX4的表达，并在碘帕醇处理的大鼠肾脏和HK-2细胞中下调ACSL4表达。机制上，SalB靶向并结合SIRT1，增强其稳定性，从而促进Nrf2上调和核转位，进而增强SLC7A11和GPX4的表达并减轻铁死亡。在HK-2细胞中沉默SIRT1或Nrf2均部分消除了SalB的保护作用。总体而言，我们的结果支持SalB作为CI-AKI的可行治疗策略。
